summary: Missing hiker found dead in Hunter Canyon; Mesa County Search and Rescue search began the evening of Oct 22 after the Mesa County Sheriff's Office requested assistance; a field team ascending a steep slope on the eastern edge found the body shortly after 10 a.m. Oct 24; recovery crews used multiple low-angle rope systems to lower the body to the valley floor and transferred it to the Mesa County Coroner's Office around 3 p.m.; victim unnamed in reporting
notes: Freshness sweep 2026-11-15: KREX/WesternSlopeNow report (published 2026-11-03) via apexnews syndication; search began Thursday 2026-10-22 (Thursday-verified), body found Saturday 2026-10-24 ~10 a.m.; search used ground teams, drones with anomaly-detection analysis, Classic Air aerial support, cell-phone forensics, and a Garfield County search dog (Rogue); victim name/age not reported.
